description: This file defines functions for engaging with a message bus, initializing, finalizing, checking bus status, and freeing resources in a C-based system, specifically for the ssp_messagebus_interface component.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Connects to the message bus, sets up callbacks, and waits for PSM readiness.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Initialize
methods.description: Performs initialization tasks; currently a placeholder returning success.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the message bus engagement, calls ssp_cancel, and returns status.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Checks the bus status; currently a placeholder returning 0.

methods.name: ssp_Mbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Frees resources based on priority; calls ssp_cancel for high priority.
